description: The existing security gate was installed more than 25 years ago and has been continuously utilized as part of the oil field facility. The gate is required for site security and regulatory compliance, as the facility must be enclosed with perimeter fencing topped with barbed wire. The gate is located approximately 60 feet east of Edwards Street and approximately 100 yards north of the Ellis intersection. The gate measures 18 feet in width and 6 feet in height and is integrated into the facility's barbed-wire security fencing system. For emergency access, the gate is equipped with a Knox key switch approved for use by the Fire Department. The gate is powered by a DoorKing Model 9100 operator and operates on a V-channel rail system with guide rollers and keypad entry. Much of the existing gate and security infrastructure was already in place when operation of the oil wells was transferred from Chevron and has remained in service as part of the facility's ongoing operations and security.
